title: Participant-held gait-state inference from bilateral STN LFP

Complete recording-grid enumeration,20 fixed lag support, null primary score and no signal/target loading.
Native/control limitations and generated fixtures versus actual clinical sampling.

evidence.supports: Freezing/voluntary-stop physiological question and original source route.
12 participants and author clinical analysis route, with hard-coded annotation exposure requiring audit.

Owner-side full12 participant-macro multiclass log loss, complete case/label/probability admission, support-matched paired lag-loss diagnostics and descriptive participant-cluster intervals. These functions do not authenticate signals, labels or participant execution.

empirical_claims.historical_evidence: No model or human trial for this task is established by this source revision. Generated software checks are not participant performance.
excluded_claims: Lag mapper is a gait-state evaluator
Time shift establishes physiology or exchangeability

disposition_reason: Complete recording-grid lag-map source and protected primary probability/paired lag-loss scoring source exist. Authenticated clinical labels and signal packets, qualified decoders and protected candidate execution remain unestablished; source availability alone does not measure neural understanding.

scientific_target.question: Can bilateral STN local field potentials distinguish freezing, voluntary stopping and other authenticated gait/postural states in an unseen participant?
scientific_target.known_answer: Original behavioral/clinical interval annotations for freezing, voluntary stop, continuous walking, sitting and standing, subject to authentic dictionary and boundary validation.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Clinical annotation and synchronized movement evidence, not labels inferred from the same LFP features being tested. Exact released categories and event clocks remain unqualified.
scientific_target.case_unit: Every fixed 2 second all-channel LFP window on a frozen recording-wide stride/grid, including background and boundary coverage.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Participant (12 reported); sessions, hemispheres, overlapping windows and gait cycles are nested.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Neural discrimination of observed movement state under participant holdout; not a causal account of freezing or validated clinical detection.
exclusions: Lag maps are not predictions or a primary score.
A large lag is not an exchangeability guarantee.
Movement channels cannot enter the neural-only classifier.

inputs: Every authenticated bilateral STN LFP channel on its native grid, physical units and all missing/artifact masks over complete 2 second windows. Actual channel count and rates require census.
forbidden_inputs: IMU/EMG, gait-event annotations, hard-coded event times, protocol filenames, clinical-state timestamps and hidden assessment labels.
observation_contract.case_identity: sensefog_pairing requires complete opaque participant/recording/segment/case identities and exact start_sample on a recording-owned grid; source clinical IDs are not delivered.
observation_contract.split: Declared leave-one-person-out over 12 participants, all sessions/hemispheres/windows grouped; each training-dependence estimate uses the other 11 people only. Actual candidate fitting not implemented.
observation_contract.coverage: Mapper retains every frozen original recording-grid case including gap/boundary/unobserved recordings and emits all 20 requested lags. Native all 12 participant census, event-state support and no-freezing cases remain to authenticate.

primary.name: Ordinary participant-macro multiclass log loss on natural recording coverage
primary.aggregation: Average -log true-state probability across all evaluable fixed-grid windows within each person, then equally across all 12 people. Finite-probability policy and authentic classes must be frozen.
primary.rationale: Preserves real background prevalence and prevents long recordings dominating; class-balanced loss is a separately named diagnostic.

secondary: Freezing sensitivity, voluntary-stop confusion, false alarms per recorded minute and onset timing with prespecified event-matching tolerance.
All 12 participant folds, state/condition/artifact coverage and people without freezing.
Original versus lagged loss on exactly shared supported cases, averaged within person then across supported people; retain unsupported people/lags.

comparators.name: Training-state prevalence
comparators.procedure: Proposed fixed prior and no-signal reference on same natural grid.

comparators.name: Causal band-power/logistic
comparators.inputs: Same all-channel 2 secondLFP, identical permitted lookback
comparators.procedure: Proposed train-only scale/features and person-group tuning.

comparators.name: Random forest or compact temporal model
comparators.inputs: Same permitted LFP/training examples and fixed compute
comparators.procedure: Proposed competent nonlinear reference; no movement channels.

nuisance_controls: Protocol/time-only auxiliary model and hard-coded event-time stripping from tools.
One common integer lag moves all channels and causal support within the same continuous acquisition segment, preserving exact observable mask sequence.
G=max(30 seconds,2 H, L_train); fixed±G...±10 G, no wrap or label-based lag choice. Unestablished H/L_train or invalid donor support remains unsupported.
evaluation.uncertainty: The scoring source implements descriptive participant-cluster percentile intervals for the complete12 person primary and support-matched paired lag differences. Overlapping windows and cycles are not independent resampling units. Authentic clinical uncertainty, scientifically accepted policy/replicate selection, permutation calibration and causal interpretation remain unestablished.
evaluation.failure_policy: The mapper declares the complete original recording grid and retains gaps and unsupported cases. The scoring source rejects missing, duplicate, extra or invalid probabilities for any original case, including cases without usable targets; paired predictions must cover exactly map-supported pairs. A participant without evaluable windows makes the full-cohort primary undefined rather than changing its denominator. The mapper alone continues to return no primary score.

implementation.scorer_target: sensefog_score.score consumes owner-supplied grid, frozen policy, complete protected labels and original probabilities to compute ordinary participant-macro multiclass log loss; optional paired probabilities produce supported-case transformed-minus-original loss diagnostics. It calls the unchanged target-free build_maps dependency and retains its full grid/20-lag coverage.
implementation.delivered_scope: Source for the complete declared12 person recording-grid mapper plus protected primary probability scoring, complete case/participant joins, explicit missing-label and undefined-cohort handling, support-matched paired lag-loss consumption and descriptive participant-cluster intervals. This is numerical evaluation source, not an authenticated clinical benchmark or participant execution.
missing: Authentic LFP/clinical interval clocks, exact class dictionary, native channels/rates/montage, prospective exclusion rules and complete person/session census.
Event-onset matching, freezing sensitivity, voluntary-stop confusion, false alarms per recorded minute, and physical original/transformed packets with matched information.
Qualified reference models, participant input/answer transport, protected execution and a frozen programme lifecycle.
implementation.execution_evidence: The mapper and scorer document generated complete12 person-grid software controls with invented1 Hz geometry, explicitly not native clinical sampling. This metadata revision runs no controls or clinical evaluation. No neural model, authentic clinical score, direct observation or native viewer result is established.
